1. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine of less than 2000 Da and a polyanion, said nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein said polyalkylenimine molecular weight is between 600 Da and 1500 Da__.

2. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle intimately associated with a multivalent cation crosslinker, __wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is present in an amount of 0.1 to 10 weight percent relative to the polyelectrolyte complex__.

3. (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyalkylenimine is polyethylenimine.

4. (Original) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyanion is selected from sodium polyvinyl sulfonate, poly (sodium acrylate), poly(sodium styrene sulfonate), copolymers of sodium acrylate with sodium vinylsulfonate or sodium styrene sulfonate; dextran sulfate, and anionic surfactants.

5. (Original) The composition of claim 2, wherein said multivalent cation crosslinker is a complexed zirconium compound selected from the group consisting of zirconium acetate, sodium zirconium lactate, zirconium sulfate, zirconium tetrachloride, zirconium orthosulfate, zirconium oxychloride, zirconium carbonate, zirconium ammonium carbonate, zirconium acetylacetonate, aluminum chloride, aluminum sulfate, aluminum citrate, tin chloride, tin sulfate, iron chloride, iron nitrate, titanium chloride, and titanium sulfate.

6. (Original) The composition of claim 1, further comprising monovalent or divalent cations selected from the group consisting of sodium, potassium, magnesium or calcium ions.

8. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex comprised a nanoparticle with an average particle size of about 100 to 900 nm in diameter, __and wherein the nanoparticle exhibits a zeta potential between -30 mV and +30 mV__.

9. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 1, wherein said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticles are stable in water, field brine and seawater, __and wherein stability is maintained for at least 30 days at temperatures between 25°C and 80°C__.

10. (Currently Amended) A composition comprising a polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle comprising a polyalkylenimine and polyvinyl sulfonate (PVS), said polyelectrolyte complex nanoparticle having a size of less than one micron, __wherein the molar ratio of polyalkylenimine to PVS is between 0.5:1 and 2:1__.

12. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 10, said nanoparticle entrapping a multivalent cation, __wherein said multivalent cation is complexed within the polyelectrolyte complex structure__.

13. (Original) The composition of claim 12, said multivalent cation comprising Zr, Cr, Ti, Fe or Al.

21. (Currently Amended) A delayed gelling composition comprising: a) a composition of claim 1; b) a polymer __having anionic functional groups__ that can be crosslinked with a); and c) a fluid.

22. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is an acrylate-based polymer, __wherein the polymer has a molecular weight between 100,000 and 5,000,000 Da__.

23. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is partially hydrolyzed polyacrylamide, __wherein the degree of hydrolysis is between 20% and 40%__.

24. (Currently Amended) The composition of claim 21, where said polymer is a polymer or copolymers of acrylate, acrylamide, N,N-dimethylacrylamide, tert-butyl acrylate, acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonic acid, or sodium 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropane sulfonate, __wherein said polymer is present in an amount of 0.5 to 5 weight percent in said delayed gelling composition__.

26. (Original) The composition of claim 21, where fluid is brine or seawater.
